lead: This is an analysis tool, not a promise of profit. Always compare the hit rate with what the market already expected: hitting lots of bets the market already rated as very likely is no credit to the model.
notice: It describes likely events; the market already prices them in. These are not betting recommendations.

callout.title: Margin over the market
callout.definition: How many points above (+) or below (−) what the market expected it hits: if the market expected 68% and it hits 71%, that's +3 pts. If the interval (95% CI) includes 0, the margin can't be told apart from chance.
callout.method: 22/23–24/25: in the Premier League and LaLiga, with the model retrained each season on earlier seasons only; in Hypermotion and Serie A, with the current model, which never saw those leagues. 25/26–26/27: the history below.

intro.highProbability: <bold>High probability:</bold> at most one selection per match, when the model gives it at least 62% and at least 3 points more than the market. It combines pre-match odds, Dixon-Coles and each team's patterns. It hits a lot because it picks likely selections, not because it knows more than the bookmakers.

emptyHighProbability: There are no high-probability selections for the upcoming matches right now. They show up once bookmakers publish their odds, usually a few days before each matchday, and only in matches where the model sees a very likely selection.
seeHistory: See how the previous ones did →

history.empty: No settled selections yet on matches already played for this filter.

note.highProbability: High-probability model selections over 25/26 and 26/27, calculated with a model trained only on earlier seasons and with thresholds fixed before seeing these matches. <bold>The margin over the market is the measure of merit</bold>, not the hit rate: always choosing what the market rates as most likely also hits a lot, and loses money. The interval (95% CI) comes from resampling the matches with a fixed seed: if it includes 0, the margin can't be told apart from chance. Misses are never left out of this list or these calculations.

origin.real: Real odds: bookmaker average, margin removed.
origin.derived: Sum of the real 1X2 odds, margin removed.
origin.realOverUnder: Real Over/Under 2.5 odds, margin removed; estimated when missing.
origin.estimated: Estimate: Poisson fitted to the 1X2 and Over/Under 2.5 odds.
